reason: Both are cloud subscription software vendors selling to small, mid-market and larger businesses. The products differ: Paylocity sells HR, payroll and finance/IT software on one HCM platform. RingCentral sells communications, meetings and AI voice/contact center software. The customer overlap is only generic (businesses of mixed size), and the buyers inside each company differ. The pair overlaps on the SaaS business model and some customers, not on product.
